title: Teach the docs and skills that the uat stop has two possible positions
action: Document what usp-1, usp-2 and usp-3 shipped. The one idea to carry into every file: the uat stop has TWO possible positions now, and uat_stop says which. Read packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/uat.rs first so every value and code name you write matches what actually shipped, and read the merge-side and close-side changes for the exact refusal codes and messages. (1) docs/handbook/register.md — add a staging_before_merge-style row for uat_stop in the config key table, beside the existing uat_before_merge row: three values merge (default, absent means this) / close / off, a non-recognized value refuses rather than guessing, and uat_before_merge is now the back-compat alias (true reads as merge, false reads as off). Update the uat_before_merge row itself to say it is an alias now, not the primary key. If the file carries a table of close doors or refusal codes, add the new uat door and the codes usp-2 and usp-3 introduced. (2) docs/config-reference.md — same key, that file's own house style, and state plainly what changes under close: the merge lands the code so the product can be reloaded and tested, the worktree is HELD (--cleanup and worktree_cleanup_on_merge true are both ignored while the wait is live), and bee close blocks until the user approves uat. (3) .bee/config-sample.json — add a _doc entry and a body entry for uat_stop; keep it valid JSON. (4) skills/bee-hive/references/gates-and-delegation.md — the uat paragraph currently says the stop sits at bee worktree merge. Rewrite it so the stop's POSITION is named as configurable: under uat_stop merge it is where it has always been; under close the merge is a publish-for-testing step and the stop is at bee close. Keep it to the file's existing length and voice; the user-only rule is unchanged and stays stated. (5) skills/bee-swarming/SKILL.md — its completion step tells the agent to present the work and ask 'Ready to merge?'. Add the close-position branch in one clause: under uat_stop close the agent merges first, then hands the user the reloaded product and asks for uat, and a failed uat is fixed in the worktree and merged again. Do not lengthen the section by more than a couple of lines. (6) Then run the FULL regen chain, in this order: .bee/bin/bee dev render-skill-trees, then .bee/bin/bee dev regen, then .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --write — and commit all regenerated output including docs/history/codex-harness-hardening/release-manifest.json.
verify: python3 -c "import json;json.load(open('.bee/config-sample.json'))" && rg -n 'uat_stop' docs/handbook/register.md docs/config-reference.md .bee/config-sample.json skills/bee-hive/references/gates-and-delegation.md skills/bee-swarming/SKILL.md && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test pointer_integrity && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test instruction_laws && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check
done_when: All five documents name uat_stop with its three values and its absent-means-merge default; uat_before_merge is described as the back-compat alias everywhere it appears; .bee/config-sample.json is valid JSON and carries both a _doc and a body entry for the key; both skill files name the two stop positions without growing more than a couple of lines each; the full regen chain has been run and its output committed; pointer-integrity and instruction-laws tests are green.
notes: Phase 3. Depends on usp-1, usp-2, usp-3 — all capped. Last cell of the slice.

truths: docs/handbook/register.md documents uat_stop with three values and the absent-means-merge default.
uat_before_merge is described as the back-compat alias, not the primary key, everywhere it is documented.
docs/config-reference.md states what changes under close: merge lands the code, the worktree is held, bee close blocks until uat is approved.
.bee/config-sample.json is valid JSON and documents uat_stop.

The full regen chain was run and its regenerated output is part of the commit.
